title: What Are the Birds Doing in the Bathing Pool?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: The bathing pool is full of small birds having a wonderful bath: wait your turn, or join them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) comes down to the bathing pool and finds it full of small birds: twenty or thirty of them, splashing, ducking their heads, fluffing up their feathers, and shaking water everywhere. They are having a wonderful time. They take no notice of (name1) at all.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) wades in anyway. The birds hop out of the way, then decide (he/she) is harmless and hop back. For a few minutes (name1) is having a bath surrounded by tiny splashing birds, which is one of the most ridiculous and wonderful things that has ever happened to (him/her). Nobody believes (him/her) later.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (name1) sits on a rock to wait. It's a long wait. The birds splash and squabble and shake themselves off, and go back for seconds. By the time they finally fly off in a cloud, (name1) has been sitting there for ages, and is laughing about it. (He/She) has a quick bath in water full of feathers.
